test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the following pie chart that shows the percentage-wise distribution of teachers who teach six different subjects, and answer the question given below.

Total number of teachers = 1600

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5706ec7846fb1f9595bb4b921a080716878e21db989311db45117205da71bcb7.png] 

If (3)/(8) of the teachers who teach Chemistry are females, then the number of male Chemistry teachers is what percentage of the total number of teachers who teach Mathematics?
solution:
Subjects
 Number of teachers
 
 

 Mathematics
 25% of 1600 = 400
 
 

 Physics
 18% of 1600 = 288
 
 

 Chemistry
 18% of 1600 = 288
 
 

 Economics
 16% of 1600 = 256
 
 

 Accountancy
 8% of 1600 = 128
 
 

 Biology
 15% of 1600 = 240

 
 
 

 

 

Number of male chemistry teachers = 288 - [(3/8) × 288]

⇒ 288 - 108

⇒ 180

Required percentage = (180/400) × 100

⇒ 45%

**∴ The number of male Chemistry teachers is 45% of the total number of teachers who teach Mathematics.**
